name: Jennifer Stark
office: City of Claremont, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Jennifer Stark is the mayor of Claremont and has represented District 3 on the City Council since 2018. She has served as a Traffic and Transportation commissioner and on the boards of Claremont Heritage and Friends of the Claremont Library. She is a founder of Claremont Canopy, a nonprofit that helps refugees in their new communities.

sentences.text: Jennifer Stark is the mayor of Claremont and has represented District 3 on the City Council since 2018.
She has served as a Traffic and Transportation commissioner and on the boards of Claremont Heritage and Friends of the Claremont Library.
She is a founder of Claremont Canopy, a nonprofit that helps refugees in their new communities.

items.text: Her campaign says she has strengthened tree protections and advanced climate-resilient policies. She chaired the city’s Emergency Preparedness Committee and helped develop its Emergency Operations Plan, according to her campaign. According to The Pomonan Magazine, her council work has focused on environmental protection, renewable energy, housing, and homelessness.
